_comment: STEP 3 with per-lithology soil parameters. SINMAP's calibration regions: each rock type gets its own C, phi and R/T where enough landslides fall in it, the rest fall back to the whole-area fit. Needs the 1.1 GB GLiM geodatabase. Worth it only where the area spans several rock types - on the small Gorkha AOI, which is 97 percent metamorphics, it finds nothing, so this config widens the extent. Use landcover instead to zone by root cohesion.
name: gorkha_litho
